summary:
A wave of new HTTP connection timeouts targeting host 34.145.189.182 represents the primary new issue in this run, led by one cluster affecting 89 tests across 43 tools and another affecting 47 tests across 26 tools. The captured error signatures show 600-second connection timeouts on port 80 during API calls and input staging, suggesting a network-level connectivity issue reaching that endpoint rather than a defect in the tool code itself. Meanwhile, persistent problems remain stable and require no new action, led by longstanding missing test input data across 7 tools and internal utility job failures across 12 tools.

The absence of database connection pool timeouts elsewhere in this run indicates the server was keeping up with load and not suffering from general system congestion. This makes a server overload explanation unlikely, pointing instead toward a network-level path or routing problem reaching that specific remote host.
